responsibility: Implements GCC’s storage-layout engine for types, fields, and objects. The file computes sizes, modes, and alignments for declarations and type nodes, lays out records/unions and bit-fields, manages sizetype variants, handles variable-sized and self-referential size expressions, and applies target and language hooks that affect field packing, alignment limits, and object representation. It also provides low-level helpers for choosing efficient machine modes for bit-field accesses and for deriving mode bounds, making it the central implementation that turns abstract tree types into concrete storage layout decisions consumed by front ends, gimplification, and RTL expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implements the storage-layout routines declared in gcc/stor-layout.h, performing actual type/field/object layout, variable-size handling, bit-field mode selection, and sizetype initialization; unlike the header, it computes concrete layout decisions rather than just exposing the API.
